tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated user, organization, and workspace context.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces available to the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Return a workspace by its identifier.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List datasets available in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Return the rows, columns, and metadata for a dataset.

exact_snapshot.description: Start an exact MVCC-bound dataset read. Exact reads start at page 0 and return a signed next_cursor when more rows remain.

cursor.description: Signed next_cursor from the preceding exact dataset page. Keep the same page_size and current_page_index sequence.

tools.name: create_dataset
tools.description: Create an empty dataset in the current workspace. Use create_dataset_column before add_dataset_rows.

tools.name: add_dataset_rows
tools.description: Add rows to an existing dataset using cells with column_name and value. Column names must already exist in the dataset.

tools.name: run_dataset_evals
tools.description: Start the configured evaluations for a dataset.

tools.name: create_dataset_column
tools.description: Create a named static input column before adding dataset rows. Supply column_type using the API schema.

tools.name: rename_dataset_column
tools.description: Rename an existing dataset column. This does not change its type or cell values.

tools.name: configure_dataset_evaluation
tools.description: Attach an evaluation template to a dataset with a lowercase name (letters, digits, hyphens or underscores; no spaces) and config.mapping column mappings. Set run=false for setup only; run=true marks it for processing. Use list_dataset_evaluations to discover the attached evaluation ID.

tools.name: list_dataset_evaluations
tools.description: List evaluations attached to a dataset by supplying eval_type=user, including their IDs, configuration and status. These IDs, not template IDs, are used by run_dataset_evals. Without eval_type=user, the API lists available evaluation templates.

eval_type.description: Use user to list evaluations attached to this dataset, including their runnable IDs.

tools.name: add_dataset_prompt
tools.description: Create a dataset prompt output column and immediately schedule processing of dataset rows. This can incur model usage charges. Supply dataset_id, name and config; this is separate from workbench run_prompt.

tools.name: update_dataset_prompt
tools.description: Update a dataset prompt column using dataset_id, column_id and config. This can schedule processing and incur model usage charges.

tools.name: run_dataset_prompts
tools.description: Queue configured dataset prompts by run_prompt_ids. Supply row_ids for selected rows, or selected_all_rows=true for all rows; with selected_all_rows=true, row_ids are EXCLUDED. Poll get_dataset for cell results and status.

tools.name: get_dataset_prompt_stats
tools.description: Return dataset prompt IDs and token, cost and timing statistics. This is not execution status; use get_dataset for cell outputs and status.

tools.name: update_dataset_cell
tools.description: Set the value of a single dataset cell. Use this to correct one value; add_dataset_rows only appends and cannot edit an existing row.

tools.name: delete_datasets
tools.description: Soft-delete one or more datasets by passing dataset_ids. This is the only way to remove a dataset created earlier; deletion cascades to the dataset's rows, columns and attached evaluations.

tools.name: list_prompt_templates
tools.description: List prompt templates available in the current workspace.

ordering.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: get_prompt_template
tools.description: Open a prompt template by its identifier, creating its workbench draft if needed.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this prompt template.

tools.name: list_prompt_versions
tools.description: List versions of a prompt template.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this prompt template.

tools.name: create_prompt_template
tools.description: Create a prompt template in the current workspace.

tools.name: update_prompt_template
tools.description: Update selected fields on an existing prompt template.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this prompt template.

tools.name: run_prompt
tools.description: Run a configured prompt version by supplying version and is_run="prompt". Optionally replace prompt_config or variable_names. Returns an asynchronous receipt; read get_prompt_run with template_version for status and output.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this prompt template.

tools.name: get_prompt_run
tools.description: Read workbench prompt execution status and outputs. Supply template_version matching the version returned by run_prompt to read that version, otherwise the API chooses the default/latest version.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this prompt template.

tools.name: list_eval_templates
tools.description: List evaluation templates using the supplied filters.

tools.name: get_eval_template
tools.description: Return an evaluation template by its identifier.

tools.name: create_eval_template
tools.description: Create an evaluation template.
Tools

tools.name: update_eval_template
tools.description: Update an existing evaluation template.
Tools

tools.name: list_eval_groups
tools.description: List evaluation groups in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_eval_group
tools.description: Return an evaluation group by its identifier.

tools.name: test_evaluation
tools.description: Execute an evaluation template against supplied test inputs.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List tracing projects available in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Return a tracing project by its identifier.

tools.name: search_traces
tools.description: Search traces using project, time range, status, and attribute filters.

page_number.description: Zero-based numbered page. Pages whose required ordered work exceeds the finite read contract return HTTP 422 with code page_depth_exceeded; request an earlier page or narrow the time range.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the previous page. When supplied, do not also send the numbered-page parameter.

attribute_keys.description: JSON-encoded list of custom attribute keys to hydrate; only requested keys are returned. Each key resolves to its latest live span value by (start_time, span_id). Comma-separated simple keys remain supported.

allow_sampled.description: Omit for backward-compatible complete bounded pages, which may label total_rows as a lower bound. Send false to require an exact total. Send true to opt in explicitly to lower-bound totals and, on the first page, a clearly labelled bounded partial result when the full ordered prefix cannot be proven inside the read budget.

tools.name: get_trace
tools.description: Return a trace by its identifier.

test_execution_id.description: A run the caller can read; opens the hidden simulation project of that run's agent.

call_execution_id.description: A run the caller can read; opens the hidden simulation project of that run's agent.

project_id.description: Project the detail was opened from. The same id can exist in several projects; when supplied, only that project's copy is read.

tools.name: list_spans
tools.description: List observation spans using the supplied filters.

page_number.description: Zero-based numbered page. Pages whose required ordered work exceeds the finite read contract return HTTP 422 with code page_depth_exceeded; request an earlier page or narrow the time range.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the previous page. When supplied, do not also send the numbered-page parameter.

allow_sampled.description: Omit for backward-compatible complete bounded pages, which may label total_rows as a lower bound. Send false to require an exact total, or true to opt in explicitly to lower-bound totals.

tools.name: get_span
tools.description: Return an observation span by its identifier.

test_execution_id.description: A run the caller can read; opens the hidden simulation project of that run's agent.

call_execution_id.description: A run the caller can read; opens the hidden simulation project of that run's agent.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List trace sessions using the supplied filters.

page_number.description: Zero-based numbered page. Pages whose required ordered work exceeds the finite read contract return HTTP 422 with code page_depth_exceeded; request an earlier page or narrow the time range.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the previous page. When supplied, do not also send the numbered-page parameter.

allow_sampled.description: Omit for backward-compatible complete bounded pages, which may label total_rows as a lower bound. Send false to require an exact total, or true to opt in explicitly to lower-bound totals.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Return a trace session by its identifier.

tools.name: get_trace_error_analysis
tools.description: Return the recorded error analysis for a trace.

tools.name: list_eval_tasks
tools.description: List online evaluation tasks in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_eval_task
tools.description: Return an online evaluation task by its identifier.

tools.name: create_eval_task
tools.description: Create an online evaluation task.

project_id.description: Project scope for the evaluation task.

date_range.description: Half-open [start, end) ISO timestamps, normalized to UTC.

date_preset.description: Which time-window preset the user chose. The frontend resolves it to date_range at save time; this records the intent so a relative window can be re-anchored on the next save. Never read when building a query — date_range remains authoritative. Absent on tasks predating this field. The enum documents the accepted values; it is not enforced.

created_at.description: Exclusive lower-bound ISO timestamp for legacy task filters, normalized to UTC.

session_id.description: Trace session id(s) to constrain the task.

trace_id.description: Trace id(s) to constrain linked-source tasks.

span_id.description: Observation span id(s) to constrain linked-source tasks.

observation_type.description: Observation span type(s), for example llm, tool, or chain.

column_id.description: Column or attribute id to filter on.

property_id.description: Optional stable namespaced Property Registry identity.

display_name.description: Optional UI label for chips and saved views.

source.description: Optional source surface for mixed-source filters, for example traces, datasets, or simulation.

output_type.description: Optional metric output type metadata used by eval and annotation filters.

filter_type.description: Canonical field type, for example text, number, boolean, datetime, categorical, thumbs, annotator, array, or map. Legacy json is value-sensitive for SPAN_ATTRIBUTE filters: list values become array and object values become map.

filter_op.description: Canonical operator from api_contracts/filter_contract.json, for example equals, not_equals, in, not_in, between, not_between, is_null, or is_not_null.

filter_value.description: Scalar, list, range tuple, boolean, or null depending on filter_op and filter_type.

col_type.description: Column family such as SYSTEM_METRIC, SPAN_ATTRIBUTE, EVAL_METRIC, ANNOTATION, or NORMAL.

attribute_value_types.description: Optional storage-family provenance aligned one-for-one with filter_value for mixed SPAN_ATTRIBUTE in/not_in filters. Null entries retain filter_type semantics for manually entered values.

tools.name: list_eval_configs
tools.description: List the custom evaluation configurations available for online evaluation tasks. The ids returned here are what create_eval_task takes in its `evals` argument - eval templates are a different object and their ids are not accepted there.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: create_eval_config
tools.description: Create a custom evaluation configuration from an eval template so it can be attached to an online evaluation task. Use when list_eval_configs has no entry for the template you want to run over spans.

tools.name: list_trace_properties
tools.description: Discover filter properties from the shared metrics catalog. Pass cursor_mode=true, page_size (at most 50), source=traces (search_traces) or source=spans (list_spans), per_eval_config=true and project_ids when known. Use role=dimension to narrow to dimensions. Use name as column_id; set filter_config.col_type by mapping category system_metric to SYSTEM_METRIC, custom_attribute to SPAN_ATTRIBUTE, eval_metric to EVAL_METRIC, and annotation_metric to ANNOTATION. Preserve property_id and source for typed attribute bindings. Follow has_more/next_cursor by passing cursor; omit page and exclude_custom_attributes in cursor mode.

tools.name: list_fired_alerts
tools.description: List alerts that have fired in numbered pages. Use this to find out what the platform has already flagged before digging into traces or error clusters.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: list_alert_rules
tools.description: List the configured alert monitors - what each one watches, its threshold and its project. Pair with list_fired_alerts to explain why an alert fired, or to see that no monitor covers a condition the user expected to be caught.

tools.name: pause_eval_task
tools.description: Pause a running online evaluation task by eval_task_id. Already-launched evaluations may finish before the worker stops.

tools.name: resume_eval_task
tools.description: Resume a paused online evaluation task by eval_task_id, scheduling remaining evaluations. May incur evaluation charges.

tools.name: list_error_clusters
tools.description: List grouped error issues detected in project traces.

tools.name: get_error_cluster
tools.description: Return an error issue and its grouped trace information.

tools.name: list_annotation_queues
tools.description: List annotation queues in the current workspace.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: get_annotation_queue
tools.description: Return an annotation queue by its identifier.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this annotation queue.

tools.name: list_annotation_queue_items
tools.description: List items belonging to an annotation queue.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: get_annotation_item_detail
tools.description: Return everything needed to annotate one queue item; reserve=true acquires an editing reservation for the caller. Includes its source content, the queue instructions, every label with its settings (the allowed values a submitted value must match), any annotations already recorded, and the next/previous item ids. Call this before submit_annotation; the label settings are not available anywhere else.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this queue item.

tools.name: submit_annotation
tools.description: Submit annotation values for an item in an annotation queue. The value shape must match the label's settings from get_annotation_item_detail. Submitting moves the item to in_progress only; call complete_annotation_item to finish it.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this queue item.

tools.name: complete_annotation_item
tools.description: Mark an annotated queue item complete and return the next item to work on. Required to finish an item - submit_annotation alone leaves it in_progress and the queue never closes.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this queue item.

tools.name: list_experiments
tools.description: List experiments in the current workspace.

ordering.description: Which field to use when ordering the results.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Return an experiment by its identifier.

tools.name: create_experiment
tools.description: Create and start an experiment. The new experiment's id is returned inside the `result` message as `experiment_id=<uuid>`; pass it to get_experiment to follow the run.

tools.name: list_optimization_runs
tools.description: List dataset optimization runs.

tools.name: get_optimization_run
tools.description: Return a dataset optimization run by its identifier.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this optimize dataset.

tools.name: create_optimization_run
tools.description: Create a dataset optimization run.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agent definitions in the current workspace.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Return an agent definition by its identifier.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: List simulation scenarios in the current workspace.

tools.name: list_test_executions
tools.description: List simulation test executions.

tools.name: get_test_execution
tools.description: Return a simulation test execution by its identifier.

tools.name: run_simulation
tools.description: Start a saved simulation test asynchronously. Omit scenario_ids to run all configured scenarios. Uses existing provider/worker infrastructure and can incur usage charges. Poll get_test_execution with the returned execution_id, then read get_test_execution_analytics.

tools.name: get_scenario
tools.description: Return a simulation scenario by its identifier.

tools.name: get_test_execution_analytics
tools.description: Return aggregated analytics for a simulation test execution.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create a text or voice agent definition and its first active version. Supply agent_name, agent_type and commit_message plus the configuration required for the chosen provider.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.description: Edit an agent definition. Leave observability_enabled out to keep observability as it is; send true or false to turn it on or off. To use changed configuration in a versioned simulation, subsequently call create_agent_version, or supply the changes directly to create_agent_version.

tools.name: create_agent_version
tools.description: Snapshot agent configuration into a new version and activate it. Can also update agent configuration. Use the returned version when creating a simulation test; existing tests may remain pinned to an older version.

tools.name: create_scenario
tools.description: Create an agent or prompt simulation scenario of kind dataset, script or graph. Generation is asynchronous and may incur usage charges; poll get_scenario until ready before running tests. Requires the applicable plan entitlement.

tools.name: update_scenario
tools.description: Edit supported scenario fields such as name, description, graph or prompt. This is not a dataset-row editor or a simulation execution.

tools.name: list_simulation_tests
tools.description: List saved simulation test configurations. A test configuration is distinct from its executions; use list_test_executions to inspect runs.

summary.description: Return the bounded list-card representation instead of the full nested run-test detail payload.

tools.name: get_simulation_test
tools.description: Read a saved simulation test configuration, its agent/version and scenarios.

tools.name: create_simulation_test
tools.description: Save a simulation test using name, agent_definition_id and scenario_ids, optionally agent_version and evaluations_config. Does not execute it; pass the returned test ID to run_simulation.

tools.name: list_gateways
tools.description: List configured AI gateways.

tools.name: get_gateway_config
tools.description: Return the effective configuration for an AI gateway.

tools.name: list_gateway_request_logs
tools.description: List request logs recorded by the AI gateway.

api_key_id.description: Gateway key id (not the API key's UUID primary key).

tools.name: list_guardrail_rules
tools.description: Per-rule guardrail trigger breakdown - which guardrail rules exist and how often each has fired. Request logs report guardrail_triggered but not which rule caused it; this is what turns "the request was blocked" into "the PII rule blocked it".

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: list_gateway_sessions
tools.description: List AI gateway sessions with their stats. These are gateway sessions, distinct from the tracing sessions returned by list_sessions. Use this to obtain a session id for list_gateway_session_requests.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: list_gateway_session_requests
tools.description: List every request log belonging to one gateway session. Request logs carry no trace id, so grouping by session is the way to see what else happened around a failed request.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this agentcc session.

tools.name: get_gateway_analytics
tools.description: Return overview usage, latency, error, and cost analytics for the AI gateway.

api_key_id.description: Gateway key id (not the API key's UUID primary key).

tools.name: list_knowledge_bases
tools.description: List knowledge bases in the current workspace.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: get_knowledge_base
tools.description: Return a knowledge base and its configuration.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this knowledge base.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards in the current workspace with their widget counts.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Return a dashboard and its widgets by identifier.

tools.name: create_dashboard
tools.description: Create an empty dashboard in the current workspace; add widgets with create_dashboard_widget.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Update the name or description of an existing dashboard.

tools.name: list_dashboard_widgets
tools.description: List the widgets on a dashboard.

page.description: A page number within the paginated result set.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

tools.name: get_dashboard_widget
tools.description: Return a dashboard widget, including its query_config and chart_config.

tools.name: create_dashboard_widget
tools.description: Add a widget to a dashboard. query_config uses the query_dashboard_metrics request shape (time_range plus metrics); discover metric names with list_dashboard_metrics.

tools.name: update_dashboard_widget
tools.description: Update selected fields on a dashboard widget, such as its query_config, chart_config, or layout.

tools.name: query_dashboard_widget
tools.description: Execute a saved widget's query and return its chart data.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Delete a dashboard and the widgets on it. This is the only way to remove a dashboard created earlier.

tools.name: query_dashboard_metrics
tools.description: Run an ad-hoc dashboard query (time_range and metrics, with optional filters and breakdowns) and return chart data without saving a widget.
